name: parity-basic
description: Baseline Jinja-subset grammar in NATIVE syntax (bare-identifier roots inside {{ }}). Acceptance target for the @cococo/jinja TS peer. The `$.`-rooted form is a SURFACE layer (cococo-surfaces / SurfaceKit), NOT this engine.
status: Verified against CococoJinja (extracted from WorkflowKit) — every case passes.
rules: Context is a single root object; top-level keys (here `state`) are addressed by bare identifiers inside `{{ }}`.
A standalone `{{ expr }}` (only whitespace around it) resolves to a TYPED value.
`{{ }}` mixed with surrounding text resolves to a STRING.
Array indexing is `[i]` (not `.i`); a missing member is null; never throws.
A string with no `{{ }}` is a literal.
